title: SPARTAN: A Sparse Transformer World Model Attending to What Matters
author: Anson Lei; Bernhard Schölkopf; Ingmar Posner
summary: SPARTAN is a new Transformer-based world model that learns local causal graphs using hard attention and sparsity regularisation. It accurately identifies object interactions, improving adaptation to changes and robustness against distractions. This approach helps build better models that predict future states from observations by focusing on important causal relationships.
